text:
Maria G.: quick heads-up — new model package arrived from partner. Label: mistral-open-7b-v2. Payload: weights + tokenizer in s3. Need provenance checks and registry gating before we start quant/bench. Who can run pre-ingest validations?
Ajay R.: I can. please drop the exact s3 paths and expected sha256 for both files. also license and owner info.
Olivia P.: created a draft registry entry: registry://draft/mistral-open-7b-v2 (placeholder). Put the artifacts under s3://redwood-models/private/mistral-open-7b-v2/ — KMS = arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456:key/abcd. Owner = research/bench, license = apache-2.0. tagging: intake:pending.
Kai L.: suggested checklist (short):
- verify sha256 for weights and tokenizer
- verify tokenizer vocab id + merge rules (vocab.json, merges.txt)
- sanity forward pass (float32) on 2 examples
- run baseline evals (LRA subset, MMLU-10, perplexity on validation split)
- attach model-card with provenance fields (source url, transfer manifest, signer)
- sign artifact with customer KMS and store signature alongside weights
Ajay R.: commands I usually run:
```bash
aws s3 cp s3://redwood-models/private/mistral-open-7b-v2/weights.pt ./ && sha256sum weights.pt
aws s3 cp s3://redwood-models/private/mistral-open-7b-v2/tokenizer.json ./ && sha256sum tokenizer.json
python tools/tokenizer_inspect.py --file tokenizer.json --dump-vocab | head -n 30
rictl register-model --id mistral-open-7b-v2 --weights s3://redwood-models/private/mistral-open-7b-v2/weights.pt --tokenizer s3://redwood-models/private/mistral-open-7b-v2/tokenizer.json --sha256 WEIGHTS_SHA --tokenizer-sha256 TOK_SHA --license apache-2.0 --owner research/bench
```
ingest-bot: automated-validation report:
- weights.pt: size=13.2GB, sha256=3f8b...c1a4 ✔
- tokenizer.json: size=4.1MB, sha256=ab12...9923 ✖ (expected ab12...991f)
- manifest.json: present ✔
- license: apache-2.0 ✔
- signature: missing ⚠
Maria G.: hm tokenizer sha mismatch by 1 hex char. could be newline normalization or transfer truncation. Ajay — can you diff the vocab hash vs vendor manifest? Also hold any registry finalize until we confirm signature.
Ajay R.: will run tokenizer diff now, but quick check — sometimes vendors upload tokenizer with different json pretty-printing which changes sha. run:
```bash
python -c "import json,sys;print(hashlib.sha256(open('tokenizer.json','rb').read()).hexdigest())"
python tools/tokenizer_inspect.py --file tokenizer.json --check-consistency --vendor-manifest vendor_manifest.json
```
Olivia P.: I'll flip registry tag to intake:investigating and add note: "hold: tokenizer sha mismatch". Also can we ask partner for signed manifest + GPG signature? add to the request.
Kai L.: for planning quant experiments: once provenance clears, baseline plan = {fp32 eval -> int8-ptq -> q4f16}. Capture evals (perplexity, accuracy suites, output diff stats) and keep RNG seed so regressions are reproducible. store eval artifacts in s3://redwood-models/bench-results/mistral-open-7b-v2/.
Maria G.: perfect. sync at 10:30 to decide next steps. If ingest-bot still flags signature missing after we re-transfer, we escalate to partner ops. :thumbsup:
ingest-bot: note: ticket created #ML-5427 to track missing signature and tokenizer mismatch.
